candidates.title: UAE and Saudi Arabia sign an MoU on electricity interconnection
candidates.snippet: MEED, 9 October 2026: the UAE and Saudi Arabia signed an MoU in Riyadh on 8 October to strengthen electricity interconnection, study the exchange and sale of power, and coordinate with other GCC states on expanding the regional interconnection. The report also describes the earlier GCCIA project: a 96 km double-circuit 400 kV line from Al-Silaa in Abu Dhabi to Salwa in Saudi Arabia.
candidates.buyer: UAE Ministry of Investment / Saudi Ministry of Energy

candidates.title: Saudi Power Procurement says about half the grid is being scaled up for demand including AI
candidates.snippet: Arab News, updated 13 October 2026: Saudi Power Procurement Co. CEO Mazin Al-Bahkali told the 25th WPC Energy Congress in Riyadh that about 50 percent of the grid is being scaled up for growing demand, including AI and data centres.
